question: Are goddesses approved on the right side of Īśa and the other gods?
premises: The verse specifies the right side of Īśa and other gods.
It concerns the placement of goddesses there.
It states that such placement is never approved.
inference: Goddesses are not approved on the right side of Īśa and the other gods.
plain_english: Goddesses are never approved on the right side of Īśa and the other gods.
